tagline: Software engineer specializing in full-stack MERN development, deterministic systems, and multi-service architectures.
bio: I am a software engineer grounded in solid computer science foundations, including data structures, object-oriented design, and database systems. Having completed my Bachelor of Science in Computer Science with a 3.7/4.0 CGPA at Sindh Madressatul Islam University, I specialize in full-stack MERN development with React, Node.js, Express, and MongoDB, engineering complex multi-service systems such as deterministic recommendation engines and role-based access control platforms.

My hands-on background includes internship and professional training experience where I developed tested RESTful APIs, implemented JWT authentication, and integrated static code analysis. Certified by IBM in Full-Stack JavaScript Development and proficient across languages like Java, C/C++, and TypeScript, I emphasize clean code, comprehensive testing with Mocha and Chai, and collaborative Git workflows to deliver dependable applications.
